ambiguity: The text mixes grounds for not extending (policy, instruction) with grounds for not releasing the box (harm, cost, targets). The final decision is that the writer would withhold the box if no decision arrives, which rests on harm, so primary_reason is harm. Responsibility is 'owns' because of 'I would not release a manifest that includes this box', although the text defers extension to the manager. Discomfort is not explicit: it describes the loss as irreversible but never says it is troubled by it. Remedy: escalation in writing before 13:30 is coded as override_request, since it asks the manager to permit an extension before destruction. The request to check whether the commissioning desk will accept a return is coded as customer_contact, which is a borderline fit. 'Expedite' is coded for the urgent escalation, though that could also be read as part of the override request.

quotes.risk_disclosure: Destruction can't be undone. This box holds the only copies of a deceased woman's letters and family photographs.
quotes.primary_reason: Missing the target is recoverable. Destruction is not.
quotes.responsibility: I would not release a manifest that includes this box
